item.title: Why Cardiff is set to win race to host Fury-Joshua
item.description: Why Cardiff is set to beat competition from London and New York to host the long-awaited fight between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua.

item.title: McConnell secures medal at European Championships
item.description: Jon McConnell secures the first medal for Team Ireland at the European Boxing Championships, while Jude Gallagher and Michaela Walsh are both one win from the podium in Sofia, Bulgaria.

item.title: Brown maintains perfect record with brutal Hedges stoppage
item.description: Pat Brown continues his perfect start to life as a professional with a seventh successive stoppage to hand John Hedges his first defeat in front of a raucous Manchester crowd.

item.title: Sheeraz withdraws from next bout & gives up WBO title
item.description: Hamzah Sheeraz has withdrawn from a proposed bout with Janibek Alimkhanuly and relinquished his WBO super-middleweight title, the sanctioning body has confirmed.

item.title: The man who would be king - the rise and fall of 'the next Prince Naseem'
item.description: Touted as the king to Naseem Hamed's prince, Daniel Teasdale's story is instead a cautionary tale.

item.title: Dreams of Old Trafford - Brown targets British title and famous nights
item.description: While British boxing fans' focus has been on world titles in recent weeks, with failed tilts by Conor Benn and Moses Itauma, Pat Brown has been preparing for a domestic bout where victory will enhance his own fast-growing reputation.

item.title: Hedges pays tribute to late trainer Hatton at weigh-in
item.description: John Hedges pays tribute Ricky Hatton by wearing a T-shirt emblazoned with images of his late trainer as he weighs in for Saturday's fight with Pat Brown in Manchester.

item.title: Brown sets sights on British title
item.description: British boxer Pat Brown is facing John Hedges in his hometown of Manchester on Saturday, but says his ultimate dream is to one day fight at Old Trafford.

item.title: Benn unsure on future after defeat by Garcia
item.description: Conor Benn says he does not know what is next in his career after a crushing world title defeat by Ryan Garcia.

item.title: Garcia reality check bursts Benn's bubble in Vegas
item.description: As the biggest night of Conor Benn's career plummets into freefall in Las Vegas, what did we learn and what does it mean for the rest of his career?

item.title: Garcia crushes overmatched Benn in two rounds
item.description: Ryan Garcia crushed Briton Conor Benn with a ruthless second-round stoppage to retain his WBC welterweight crown in a world title mismatch in Las Vegas.

item.title: Watch every episode
item.description: Natasha Jonas and Chris Eubank Jr feature

item.title: A car in the gym? At home with Conor Benn
item.description: Go behind the scenes at home with Conor Benn, before his Las Vegas showdown with Ryan Garcia.

item.title: 'I grew up watching you' - women's boxing honours Taylor
item.description: Women's boxing greats, including Claressa Shields and Amanda Serrano, pay tribute to Katie Taylor as she prepares to retire after Saturday's fight with Flora Pili.

item.title: Tears, blood and triumph - Taylor's iconic career in pictures
item.description: As Katie Taylor hangs up her gloves, BBC Sport picks the best pictures of her career.

item.title: Five moments that shaped Taylor's legendary career
item.description: From writing a letter to her idol as a 10-year-old to messaging a promoter on social media, here are five sliding doors moments that helped shape Katie Taylor’s career.

item.title: Ali 'The Greatest' but Maguire the latest to win in Croke Park
item.description: With Katie Taylor set to be the first boxer to headline Croke Park since Muhammad Ali beat Al 'Blue' Lewis in 1972, BBC Sport NI catches up with Paddy Maguire, who was last to box on that iconic night.

item.title: From influencers to queens of women's boxing - five years of MVP
item.description: On Saturday, Most Valuable Promotions celebrates its fifth anniversary. One of the feistiest upstarts in modern boxing has given a new platform to the world's best female fighters.

item.title: Heavyweight Itauma handed harsh world-title lesson
item.description: British heavyweight Moses Itauma was taught a harsh lesson at world level - what can he learn from defeat and where does the 21-year-old go next?

item.title: From Love Island to Commonwealth gold for McConnell
item.description: Team Northern Ireland boxer Jon McConnell tells BBC Sport NI of his decision to reject Love Island to pursue his childhood dream of winning Commonwealth gold, which he achieved with a split decision win over Wales' Orlando Holley-Sotomi.

item.title: How lightbulb moment in Hazard's apartment helped Sheeraz
item.description: Former Chelsea winger Eden Hazard is a surprise inspiration for Britain's Hamzah Sheeraz on his path to world championship glory.

item.title: 'You're under arrest' - how Ngamba made history against all odds
item.description: Cindy Ngamba shares her incredible story from refugee to Olympic medallist.

item.title: 'I wouldn't wish what I went through on my worst enemy'
item.description: Undisputed middleweight boxing world champion Claressa Shields opens up about her harrowing journey to the top of her sport.

item.title: From rock bottom to three world titles at 37
item.description: Natasha Jonas tells her story, including what it took to come back and win three world titles at 37.

item.title: Being a Eubank, living up to dad and dealing with grief
item.description: Born To Brawl: Chris Eubank Jr tells his story of grief and living up to his dad

item.title: Are Prince Naseem Hamed's sons coming for his throne?
item.description: Get to know the Hameds' journey ahead of Aadam Hamed's debut on the Oleksandr Usyk v Daniel Dubois undercard.

item.title: Tyson rates him: Is traveller Dennis McCann boxing's next superstar?
item.description: Tyson Fury tips traveller boxer Dennis ‘The Menace’ McCann as future world champion

item.title: Phantom v Price - can a Gladiator keep up with a world champion?
item.description: Lauren Price meet Gladiator Phantom for a training session in the boxing gym.

item.title: Church told me I was possessed by demons aged 12
item.description: Conor Benn tells BBC Sport about growing up in an "extreme" Christian school, being told he was "demon-possessed" and how he had to rebuild a relationship with his father Nigel.

item.title: 'I gave everything to boxing and still have nothing'
item.description: Heather Hardy tells BBC Sport how she is adapting to life outside of boxing after the former world champion was left with a life-threatening injury.
